grammar.title: Suddenly remembering with 想起
grammar.explanation: 想起 (xiǎngqǐ) means "to recall, to suddenly think of/remember" it describes a memory surfacing, often unplanned.

grammar.title: Looking after someone with 照顾
grammar.explanation: 照顾 (zhàogu) means "to take care of, to look after" used for people (children, patients, family) or things needing attention.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ le yí jiàn shì.
Tā xiǎngqǐ le yǐqián de lǎoshī.
sentences.en: He thought of his former teacher.

sentences.zh: 看到照片，我想起了那天。
sentences.pinyin: Kàndào zhàopiàn, wǒ xiǎngqǐ le nèi tiān.
sentences.en: Seeing the photo, I remembered that day.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ le wǒ māma.
sentences.en: You remind me of my mom.
Mom takes great care of us.
Who takes care of this child?
The doctor takes care of the patients.
Please take good care of yourself.
